import numpy as np
import networkx as nx
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.decomposition import FastICA

def conditional_independence_test(X, Y, Z, data, alpha=0.05):
    """Test if X ⊥ Y | Z using partial correlation."""
    if Z is None or len(Z) == 0:
        # Simple correlation test
        r, p_value = stats.pearsonr(data[:, X], data[:, Y])
        return p_value > alpha, r
    
    # Partial correlation via regression residuals
    Z_data = data[:, Z]
    
    # Regress X on Z
    if Z_data.ndim == 1:
        Z_data = Z_data.reshape(-1, 1)
    
    coef_X = np.linalg.lstsq(Z_data, data[:, X], rcond=None)[0]
    resid_X = data[:, X] - Z_data @ coef_X
    
    coef_Y = np.linalg.lstsq(Z_data, data[:, Y], rcond=None)[0]
    resid_Y = data[:, Y] - Z_data @ coef_Y
    
    # Correlation of residuals
    r, p_value = stats.pearsonr(resid_X, resid_Y)
    
    return p_value > alpha, r

def pc_algorithm(data, alpha=0.05):
    """Implement the PC algorithm for causal discovery."""
    n_vars = data.shape[1]
    n_samples = data.shape[0]
    
    # Start with complete undirected graph
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(range(n_vars))
    for i in range(n_vars):
        for j in range(i + 1, n_vars):
            G.add_edge(i, j)
    
    # Store separating sets
    sep_sets = {}
    
    # Conditional independence testing
    max_cond_size = min(n_vars - 2, 3)  # Limit for computational reasons
    
    for cond_size in range(max_cond_size + 1):
        edges_to_remove = []
        
        for (i, j) in list(G.edges()):
            # Get possible conditioning sets
            neighbors_i = set(G.neighbors(i)) - {j}
            neighbors_j = set(G.neighbors(j)) - {i}
            possible_Z = neighbors_i | neighbors_j
            
            if len(possible_Z) < cond_size:
                continue
            
            # Test all subsets of size cond_size
            from itertools import combinations
            for Z in combinations(possible_Z, cond_size):
                Z = list(Z)
                independent, _ = conditional_independence_test(i, j, Z, data, alpha)
                
                if independent:
                    edges_to_remove.append((i, j))
                    sep_sets[(i, j)] = set(Z)
                    sep_sets[(j, i)] = set(Z)
                    break
        
        G.remove_edges_from(edges_to_remove)
    
    # Orient v-structures
    DAG = nx.DiGraph()
    DAG.add_nodes_from(range(n_vars))
    
    for i in range(n_vars):
        for j in range(n_vars):
            if i == j or not G.has_edge(i, j):
                continue
            
            # Check for v-structure: i -> k <- j
            common_neighbors = set(G.neighbors(i)) & set(G.neighbors(j))
            for k in common_neighbors:
                if (i, j) not in sep_sets.get((i, j), set()):
                    # Orient as v-structure
                    if not DAG.has_edge(i, k):
                        DAG.add_edge(i, k)
                    if not DAG.has_edge(j, k):
                        DAG.add_edge(j, k)
    
    # Add remaining undirected edges
    for (i, j) in G.edges():
        if not DAG.has_edge(i, j) and not DAG.has_edge(j, i):
            DAG.add_edge(i, j)  # Default orientation
    
    return DAG, sep_sets

def lingam(data):
    """Simplified LiNGAM algorithm."""
    n_samples, n_vars = data.shape
    
    # Center the data
    data = data - data.mean(axis=0)
    
    # Apply FastICA
    ica = FastICA(random_state=42)
    S = ica.fit_transform(data)
    
    # Estimate mixing matrix
    A = np.linalg.pinv(ica.components_)
    
    # Find causal ordering by finding permutation that makes A lower triangular
    # Simplified: use correlation-based ordering
    ordering = np.argsort(np.abs(np.diag(A)))[::-1]
    
    # Estimate adjacency matrix
    B = np.eye(n_vars) - np.linalg.inv(A)
    B = B[ordering][:, ordering]
    
    # Threshold small values
    B[np.abs(B) < 0.1] = 0
    
    return B, ordering

def anm_test(X, Y, data):
    """Test causal direction using Additive Noise Model."""
    x_data = data[:, X]
    y_data = data[:, Y]
    
    # Direction X -> Y: Y = f(X) + N_Y
    coef_XY = np.polyfit(x_data, y_data, 1)
    pred_XY = np.polyval(coef_XY, x_data)
    resid_XY = y_data - pred_XY
    
    # Direction Y -> X: X = f(Y) + N_X
    coef_YX = np.polyfit(y_data, x_data, 1)
    pred_YX = np.polyval(coef_YX, y_data)
    resid_YX = x_data - pred_YX
    
    # Test independence using distance correlation (simplified)
    # Use HSIC-like test: correlation of residuals with predictor
    indep_XY = abs(stats.spearmanr(x_data, resid_XY)[0])
    indep_YX = abs(stats.spearmanr(y_data, resid_YX)[0])
    
    if indep_XY < indep_YX:
        return 'X -> Y', indep_XY, indep_YX
    else:
        return 'Y -> X', indep_YX, indep_XY
